messages:
Priya (Support): FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — huge latency spike ~2h ago and unexpected hosted charges. They claim traffic should have stayed on their dedicated pool in eu-west-1.
Ava (Customer Success): Customer says: 95th p50 went from 80ms -> 1.2s, plus sudden billing line items for hosted tokens. They sent request IDs and sample request headers.
Priya (Support): I grabbed logs. Example request id: req_44f3a. Routing decision shows target_pool=shared-hosted-eu and tenant_pool=dedicated-eu-01. Looks like fallthrough happened.
Lee (SRE): Can you paste the routing log lines (no PII)? Also any auth errors (401/403) or rate-limit (429)?
Priya (Support): Logs:
```
2026-02-15T10:12:01Z req=req_44f3a tenant=acme id=44f3a hdrs={X-Region: \"eu-west-1\", region_hint: null} route_decision=fallthrough -> shared-hosted-eu reason=\"no binding\"
2026-02-15T10:12:01Z req=req_44f3a auth=200 pool=shared-hosted-eu latency_ms=1123
```
Priya (Support): No 401s in the first sample, just higher latency and billing attributing to shared pool token usage.
Marco (Infra Eng): Huh — region_hint null. We've been onboarding a rollout that renamed the client hint from `region_hint` -> `region` in the header parser. If a tenant still sends `region_hint` it might not be read by the new matcher, causing the binding lookup to fail and fallthrough to hosted.
Ava (Customer Success): Customer says they didn't change anything client side. Their SDK was pinned. Could the edge rewrite be stripping headers? They saw the header in their outgoing traces.
Lee (SRE): Possible: envoy filter we rolled in last week normalizes headers and drops unknown-underscore headers. Also we recently tightened header whitelist for the EU edge. Need to verify header normalize ruleset.
oncall-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-3456. Priority: High. Assigned: Lee (SRE).
Lee (SRE): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Add a temporary tenant-specific route binding rule in control plane that maps tenant acme -> dedicated-eu-01 by tenant_id. 2) Disable hosted-fallback for that tenant. 3) Roll back header-normalize change if we confirm it's the cause.
Priya (Support): Customer asked for repro steps. I gave them: include X-Region: eu-west-1 and `region_hint: eu-west-1` in header and send single request to api.redwood.example/dev/generate, capture req id.
Marco (Infra Eng): To add control-plane rule (temporary):
```
# admin CLI
redwood-admin routes add --tenant acme --pool dedicated-eu-01 --force
redwood-admin tenant update --id acme --allow_hosted_fallback false
```
Marco (Infra Eng): I pushed the rule to staging. Will promote to prod after lee signs off.
Lee (SRE): Before promoting, run quick sanity check: curl sample call that previously landed on shared-hosted:
```
curl -v -H \"X-Region: eu-west-1\" -H \"region_hint: eu-west-1\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"test\"}'
```
Priya (Support): Also capturing a request where header was present but still fell through: attached logs show header present at client egress but missing at edge ingress.
Ava (Customer Success): I'll nudge the customer to keep live traces and confirm once we flip the rule.
Billing Bot: Alert: detected hosted token usage for tenant=acme between 2026-02-15T09:40 and 2026-02-15T11:10. Estimate extra charge: $1,240. Charge IDs: ch_8a3, ch_8a4.
Lee (SRE): I checked Envoy filter history — we merged a header whitelist change two days ago that strips headers with underscores unless explicitly allowed. That explains region_hint being dropped. We should not silently drop customer routing hints.
Marco (Infra Eng): Agreed. Two actions: (A) allow `region_hint` in the whitelist, (B) backfill parsing logic to accept both `region` and `region_hint` for 2 weeks to avoid flapping.
Lee (SRE): I'm going to add the tenant binding rule now and flip allow_hosted_fallback=false for acme.
Priya (Support): Rule applied. Observability: new requests for req_5a7b now show pool=dedicated-eu-01 latency ~90ms.
Ava (Customer Success): Customer confirms metrics improving on their side. They saw p95 drop back to 120ms. :party-parrot:
Priya (Support): Billing asked about refund. Billing Bot, can we review chargeable tokens and apply credit for the period the tenant was misrouted?
Billing Bot: Noted. We'll open a billing review BR-2026-778 and estimate refundable amount after accounting for committed capacity credits.
Lee (SRE): Long term fix tracked: ENG-5944 — restore header compatibility + add e2e test that simulates header variants. Marco will own parser backfill.
Marco (Infra Eng): I'll open a PR to accept both header names and add unit tests. Also propose a canary for whitelist changes to include synthetic tenant routes so we catch this earlier.
Priya (Support): Closing the customer loop now. Will post summary and link incident and billing ticket.
Ava (Customer Success): Customer asked for a short incident summary and ETA on credit. I'll coordinate with Billing and share with them.
Lee (SRE): Marking incident resolved in monitoring after 30m stable. Leaving ENG ticket until parser fix is merged.
Priya (Support): Thanks team. Follow-ups: ENG-5944, BR-2026-778, INC-2026-3456.
